revised_prompts: Photorealistic 1920x1080 landscape frame from a fixed safety-inspection camera mounted about 1.5 meters above the floor, showing an office corridor with glass partitions, doors, practical overhead lights, rubberized safety flooring, and neutral indoor illumination. Moderate side view at moderate camera distance, natural perspective, realistic scale, enough surrounding context to judge body support. A young adult woman with an athletic build, wearing a pale sweater and black trousers with black and teal clothing elements, is kneeling on both knees with shins and knees actively supporting the body while the torso remains upright. Plausible unedited inspection-camera capture, subject clearly visible, practical clutter kept behind the subject, no foreground obstruction. Ordinary photographic detail, restrained contrast, not cinematic or advertising style. No text, caption, watermark, logo, warning label, overlay, bounding box, arrow, circle, or annotation.
